name: Yuukan Madam Club
source:
The protagonist, having just transferred schools and lacking close friends, one day strikes up a conversation with Chris, a handsome blond boy in class, and they hit it off, growing closer. When invited to his house to hang out, the protagonist is stunned to find it's an incredibly grand mansion. The garden has a pool, and Chris's room is incomparably luxurious compared to the protagonist's own.

When Chris leaves the room, the protagonist accidentally discovers files on his computer and peeks inside. There, he finds a massive collection of images and videos showing Chris having sex with a woman who appeared to be his mother...

Chris then reveals their forbidden parent-child relationship and offers to let him have sex with his mother if he desires. Unable to resist the temptation and lust, he ends up having sex with Chris's mother...

This marks the beginning of relationships with other mothers of classmates, and eventually, he even ends up having sex with his own mother...

Where will this forbidden parent-child love lead...?

Parent-child relationships without blood ties gradually become deeper and more complicated. Stepmother, stepmama, stepmommy... The love and dignity of each stepchild.

[From the [url=https://www.empress-game.com/yukanmadam/]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公刚刚转学，缺乏亲密的朋友，有一天与班上金发帅哥克里斯搭讪，两人一拍即合，关系越来越亲密。当主角被邀请到他家闲逛时，他惊讶地发现这是一座令人难以置信的宏伟豪宅。花园里有泳池，克里斯的房间和主角自己的相比奢华无比。

当克里斯离开房间时，主角无意中发现了他电脑上的文件并偷看了里面。在那里，他发现了大量的图像和视频，显示克里斯与一名似乎是他母亲的女人发生性关系……

克里斯随后透露了他们被禁止的亲子关系，并提出如果他愿意的话可以让他与母亲发生性关系。由于无法抗拒诱惑和欲望，他最终与克里斯的母亲发生了性关系……

这标志着他与同学的其他母亲发生关系的开始，最终，他甚至与自己的母亲发生了性关系……

这段禁忌的亲子之爱将走向何方……？

没有血缘关系的亲子关系逐渐变得更深、更复杂。继母、继母、继母……每个继子的爱和尊严。

[摘自[url=https://www.empress-game.com/yukanmadam/]官网[/url]]
